blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Philippine National Police (PNP) Forensic Group said 50 of the 71 remains recovered from the burned MV June Aster in Coron, Palawan, have been identified and cross-matched through DNA testing. PNP Forensic Group Director Brig. Gen. Pierre Paul Carpio disclosed the figures in a press briefing on Monday. “So we have the remaining 21 cadavers for cross-matching,” he added. The PNP deployed Disaster Victim Identification (DVI) and Scene of the Crime Operations (SOCO) teams to the area to help identify the victims.
